sourcesTried.note: 38 successful queries. The 39th query returned 'web search budget exhausted (200 of 200 calls for this session)' - the budget is shared across the session, so no further searches were possible. As a result, marketplace competition checks for the Cosmic Reset and Poetcore product angles, the Practica
newsroom.pinterest.com blocked by egress proxy; all Pinterest figures below come from search-result summaries of the newsroom page and of press coverage.
Listed as blocked in the brief; no search-interest time series was measured for any candidate.
Blocked per brief. Etsy listings were seen only as search-result titles/snippets; no listing counts were measured.
Only discover-page titles and search summaries were visible; no view counts were seen or recorded.

discovered.name: Kitchen Witch (Practical Magic 2-era witchy apothecary kitchen)
discovered.whyConsidered: Named trend in Pinterest's 2026 Hobbies Trend Report (released ~2026-08-25) with large reported search increases; reinforced by Practical Magic 2's No. 1 box-office opening (weekend of 2026-09-11/13), licensed decor/apparel partnerships, TikTok kitchen-makeover content and fall design press.

discovered.name: Cosmic Reset (beginner astrology, tarot, crystals, astrocartography)
discovered.whyConsidered: Pinterest 2026 Hobbies Trend Report reported the largest figures in the report for this trend ('learn astrology' +733%, 'crystals and meanings' +606%, 'tarot cards for beginners' +558%); aligns with New-Year / 2027 planner buying.

discovered.name: Poetcore (the poet aesthetic)
discovered.whyConsidered: Pinterest Predicts 2026 ('the poet aesthetic' +175%), picked up across fashion press in Dec 2025-Jan 2026 and described as an autumn 2026 trend; literary theme maps naturally to stationery, journals and poetry posters.

discovered.name: Whimsigoth
discovered.whyConsidered: Fall 2026 design press (Inman, 2026-09-11) and licensed Practical Magic 2 collections (MacKenzie-Childs, Wayfair) frame the film's look as whimsigoth.
discovered.rejectReason: Not a separate candidate: same demand driver (Practical Magic 2) and overlapping motifs as Kitchen Witch, so merged into that candidate as an alias/adjacent aesthetic per the dedup rule.

discovered.name: Weekend Equestrian / equestrian decor
discovered.whyConsidered: Pinterest Hobbies report: 'barn jacket outfit women' +1,109%, 'equestrian aesthetic outfit' +219% (reported via WWD); Homes & Gardens and House Digest call equestrian decor a 2026 trend.
discovered.rejectReason: Pinterest signal is apparel (barn jackets, riding boots), not wall art or paper goods; decor coverage advises against on-the-nose horse motifs (a single statement piece); horse-print competition could not be checked after search budget ran out. Watch for 2027.

discovered.name: Home Cafe Engineering (vintage coffee corner)
discovered.whyConsidered: Pinterest Hobbies report: 'vintage coffee corner' +430%; a secondary article also cites 'coffee station ideas party' +624%. Natural fit for coffee-bar menu printables and cafe wall art.
discovered.rejectReason: Evidence limited to Pinterest's report via secondary summaries; competition for coffee-bar signs/menus could not be checked (search budget exhausted) and is plausibly heavy given how long coffee-bar decor has been sold. Good fallback idea, but less evidenced than the three deep dives.

discovered.name: Curated Clutter (styled collections / cluttercore)
discovered.whyConsidered: Pinterest Hobbies report trend covered by Domino and Apartment Therapy (Pokemon cards +570%, figure display shelf +79%, DVD collection display +41%).
discovered.rejectReason: Demand is for physical collectibles and display furniture, much of it fandom IP (Pokemon, anime); weak fit for original printables/POD.

discovered.name: Backyard Botanist (herbarium / field-guide sketching)
discovered.whyConsidered: Pinterest Hobbies report trend: pressed flowers, watercolour sketchbooks, illustrated field guides.
discovered.rejectReason: Adopters want to make their own art rather than buy it; vintage botanical prints are a long-established evergreen category; the herb/apothecary overlap is captured by the Kitchen Witch candidate.

discovered.name: Neo Deco (Art Deco revival)
discovered.whyConsidered: Pinterest Predicts 2026 interiors trend (vintage bar carts +100%, red marble bathrooms +80%, pendant lamps +40% per nss magazine), and Houzz also listed an Art Deco revival for 2026.
discovered.rejectReason: Driven by furniture and finishes (chrome, brass, fluted glass); Art Deco posters are a long-standing evergreen print category; no fall-2026 acceleration signal found. Possible New Year's Eve party-printable angle, but not differentiated.

discovered.name: Extra Celestial / alien-core (Pinterest 'Ovnipresent')
discovered.whyConsidered: Pinterest Predicts 2026: 'alien core aesthetic' +80%, 'opalescent' +115% (reported via AOL/House Digest syndication).
discovered.rejectReason: Data is from Sept 2024-Aug 2025; no fall-2026 follow-up signal found; holographic/opalescent finishes don't translate well to flat prints. The celestial appetite is better captured by the Cosmic Reset candidate.

discovered.name: FunHaus / Chapithome (circus stripes decor)
discovered.whyConsidered: Pinterest Predicts 2026 interiors trend (bold stripes, sculptural shapes, a touch of camp).
discovered.rejectReason: No 2026 follow-up evidence found; furniture/textile-led; insufficient evidence.

discovered.name: Afrohemian decor
discovered.whyConsidered: Pinterest Predicts 2026: Afro-bohemian decor +220%, Berber +210% (reported).
discovered.rejectReason: No fall-2026 follow-up signal; draws on specific African textile and art traditions (adire, Ethiopian art), which raises appropriation risk for a creator outside those communities; better served by creators from them.

discovered.name: Laced Up (lace / doily motifs)
discovered.whyConsidered: Pinterest Predicts 2026: lace nails +215%, lace bandanas +150%, lace doily +105%.
discovered.rejectReason: Beauty/fashion-led and close to the fading coquette look; weak printable fit beyond generic digital papers; no fall-2026 follow-up signal.

discovered.name: Glamoratti (80s luxury)
discovered.whyConsidered: Pinterest Predicts 2026: '80s luxury' +225%, baggy suits +90%.
discovered.rejectReason: Fashion/beauty trend with no clear paper-goods or wall-art demand.

discovered.name: Whimsymaxxing
discovered.whyConsidered: PureWow, TODAY and Inside Retail describe it as a maximalist joy trend (bag charms, stacked accessories, rhinestones); a September 2026 TikTok roundup listed it.
discovered.rejectReason: Mostly about physical accessories and embellishing objects; TODAY framed it as a summer trend; weak fit for digital/POD paper goods (stickers possible but undifferentiated).

discovered.name: Gothic romance / 'Wuthering Heights' effect
discovered.whyConsidered: Numero, Dengarden and others tie a 2026 shift to dark romanticism (corsets, lace, velvet, burgundy) to the February 2026 Wuthering Heights film.
discovered.rejectReason: The film came out eight months ago; the signal is fashion/wedding-led. For fall, the darker romantic decor appetite overlaps the Kitchen Witch/whimsigoth candidate, which has a fresher catalyst.

discovered.name: Narnia (Greta Gerwig's The Magician's Nephew) aesthetic
discovered.whyConsidered: Was expected as a Thanksgiving-2026 IMAX release that could drive a wintry Narnia aesthetic.
discovered.rejectReason: Release moved to Feb 12, 2027 (IMAX previews Feb 10; Netflix Apr 2, 2027) per Variety/ABC; outside the Q4 2026 window; high IP risk. Watch for Q1 2027.

discovered.name: Etsy 2026 Color/Texture of the Year: Patina Blue and Washed Linen
discovered.whyConsidered: Etsy's official 2026 picks; Etsy reported linen clothing searches up over 1,200%.
discovered.rejectReason: A color and a fabric, not a motif; the linen signal is for physical textiles/clothing.

discovered.name: Plum Noir / 'plum, olive and fig' palette
discovered.whyConsidered: eRank's Fall 2026 Etsy-seller blog flags Plum Noir for stationery and dark florals; one result cited 'plum and olive wedding' +1,380%.
discovered.rejectReason: A palette, not an aesthetic; comes from third-party SEO/seller-tool blogs; the source of the +1,380% figure could not be traced.

discovered.name: Snowy leopard print
discovered.whyConsidered: eRank Fall 2026 blog: grey/white/black leopard on faux fur, velvet, fleece.
discovered.rejectReason: Textile/apparel pattern from a third-party blog; generic; weak paper-goods fit.

discovered.name: Polka dots
discovered.whyConsidered: Etsy reported polka dot phone cases +835% in its 2026 trend coverage.
discovered.rejectReason: A spring/summer 2026 signal for phone cases; generic pattern with no defensible angle for fall.

discovered.name: Nutcrackercore
discovered.whyConsidered: Third-party Etsy-trend blogs claim '1000% year-over-year growth' in related searches.
discovered.rejectReason: Figure appears only in SEO blogs without a traceable Etsy source and may be recycled from an earlier year; nutcracker holiday decor is an established, crowded seasonal category. Not verified.
